title: Intimate Waterway Tours

services.name: 1 Hour 30 Minute Private Waterway Tour
services.desc: Immerse Yourself in the Amazing Sights of Fort Lauderdale! Rates Private Excursion: $249 (For up to 6 people, all ages) Group Price Gratuities not included, but always appreciated. Duration 1 Hour 30 minutes About Experience an Intimate Waterway Tour with Fort Lauderdale’s finest Electric boat tour. Immerse yourself in the Amazing Sights of Fort Lauderdale’s unique network of beautiful canals. These waterways are the heart of South Florida’s finest boating destination, making Fort Lauderdale the Yachting Capital of the World. On Our Boat, you will cruise in comfort and style. Book Public Waterway Cruise (up to 6 passengers), or reserve the Private Boat Tour for a private experience. Wine

services.name: Day/Evening Wine Cruise
services.desc: Sit back and enjoy a glass of wine for the cruise of a lifetime! Rates Private Excursion: $259.95, Includes the price of 2 bottles of wine (For up to 6 people, all ages) Gratuities not included, but always appreciated. Duration 90 minutes About See the sights while enjoying 2 bottles of wine on this intimate excursion. After the sun goes down, the tranquil evening tours are abuzz with ambient lights flickering off the water. The lights adorning the waterfront mansions and yachts are truly enchanting, and it is the perfect time to let go and float along in a comfortable and relaxing environment. In other words, leave your worries behind, and sit back for the cruise of a lifetime. Cruise
